articles.summary: Cord blood banking is a process of collecting and storing the blood that remains in the umbilical cord and placenta after the birth of a baby. The blood contains stem cells that can be used for medical purposes, such as treating certain diseases and disorders. Despite its benefits, there are still misconceptions and myths surrounding cord blood banking that prevent some parents from considering it as an option. In this article, we will be debunking some of the most common misconceptions parents have about cord blood banking.
articles.title: Misconceptions Parents Have About Cord Blood Banking
